item.rancraft.rf_lens.tooltip.drivetest: Trail layer: /rancraftc drivetest export saves it as CSV
commands.rancraftc.drivetest.exported: Drive test: %s sample(s) from %s written to %s

item.rancraft.network_locator.tooltip.wh: Locates you from the cell towers you hear (not GPS)
item.rancraft.network_locator.tooltip.us: Use: next waypoint  Sneak + use: save the estimate
rancraft.locator.waypoint.no_reading: Network Locator: no current reading. Hold it a moment first.
rancraft.locator.waypoint.no_fix: Network Locator: nothing to save, the Locator has no FIX (%s)
rancraft.locator.waypoint.none: Network Locator: no waypoints yet. Sneak + use saves the estimate.

rancraft.locator.waypoint.replaced: Waypoint %s/%s replaced: x %s z %s, ±%s m (the estimate, not where you stand)
block.rancraft.radio_link_transmitter.to: Sends its redstone input through the cell network to every receiver on its address
block.rancraft.radio_link_receiver.toolt: Outputs redstone while a transmitter on its address is powered
block.rancraft.radio_link.tooltip.rate: Updates arrive about once a second, by design: not for clocks
block.rancraft.radio_link.tooltip.servic: Both ends need POOR service or better. Low SINR loses updates; a lost one leaves the old state
block.rancraft.radio_link.tooltip.use: Use: address up  Sneak + use (empty hand): address down
block.rancraft.core_site.tooltip: The core network: every cell's traffic has to reach one
block.rancraft.core_site.tooltip.fiber: Cells and Backhaul Dishes near it are on fiber (implicit: nothing to lay)
rancraft.core_site.status: Core Site: on fiber within %s blocks (horizontally)
block.rancraft.backhaul_dish.tooltip: One end of a point-to-point microwave link (18 GHz)
block.rancraft.backhaul_dish.tooltip.sit: Serves the cells whose base is near it; pair two with a Link Tool
block.rancraft.backhaul_dish.tooltip.use: Use: the link's state, RSL, margin, Fresnel zone and rain loss
rancraft.backhaul_dish.unpaired: Backhaul Dish: not paired. Use a Link Tool on it and on the far dish. Reaches the core: %s
rancraft.backhaul_dish.unmeasured: Backhaul Dish -> %s: not measured yet. Reaches the core: %s
rancraft.backhaul_dish.hop: Backhaul Dish -> %s: %s. Weather: %s. Reaches the core: %s
item.rancraft.link_tool.tooltip.use: Use on a Backhaul Dish, then on the far dish, to pair them
item.rancraft.link_tool.tooltip.unpair: Sneak + use on a dish: unpair it
rancraft.link_tool.selected: Link Tool: dish at %s selected. Now use it on the far dish.
rancraft.link_tool.same: Link Tool: that is the dish already selected. Use it on the far dish.
rancraft.link_tool.other_dimension: Link Tool: the selected dish is in another dimension. Selected the dish at %s instead.
rancraft.link_tool.gone: Link Tool: the dish at %s is gone. Selected the dish at %s instead.
rancraft.link_tool.too_far: Link Tool: the dishes are %s blocks apart, over the %s-block limit (maxEvaluationRangeBlocks).
rancraft.link_tool.paired: Link Tool: paired %s with %s (%s m). Alignment is automatic; the link is measured within %s s.
rancraft.link_tool.unpaired: Link Tool: dish unpaired, and its partner with it.
rancraft.link_tool.not_paired: Link Tool: this dish is not paired.

commands.rancraft.backhaul.not_solved: Backhaul: nothing measured yet in this dimension (no Core Site or Backhaul Dish, and requireBackhaul is off).
commands.rancraft.backhaul.off_air: Off the air for want of backhaul (%s):
commands.rancraft.backhaul.no_backhaul: No backhaul, still on the air because requireBackhaul is off (%s):
commands.rancraft.backhaul.limited_off: LIMITED, no cap because requireBackhaul is off (%s):
item.rancraft.storage_terminal.tooltip.w: Opens a chest or barrel in the data centre over the mobile network
item.rancraft.storage_terminal.tooltip.n: Needs %s service on a band of tier %s or higher (backhaul-limited cells cap it)
item.rancraft.storage_terminal.tooltip.b: Sneak + use a chest or barrel near a Core Site to bind it
rancraft.storage_terminal.bound: Storage Terminal: bound to the %s at %s (Core Site %s blocks away).
rancraft.storage_terminal.bind_not_stora: Storage Terminal: only a chest or a barrel can be bound.
rancraft.storage_terminal.bind_no_core: Storage Terminal: no Core Site within %s blocks of this %s. Network storage lives in the data centre: put it near a Core Site.
rancraft.storage_terminal.problem.not_bo: not bound. Sneak + use a chest or barrel near a Core Site
rancraft.storage_terminal.problem.other_: storage unreachable: it is in %s, and the terminal only reaches its own dimension
rancraft.storage_terminal.problem.no_rea: no signal reading. Carry it in a hand or the hotbar for a moment
rancraft.storage_terminal.problem.backha: backhaul limited: the serving cell is capped at %s, needs %s
rancraft.storage_terminal.problem.no_cor: storage unreachable: no Core Site within %s blocks of %s
rancraft.storage_terminal.problem.unload: storage unreachable: its chunk is not loaded (%s)
rancraft.storage_terminal.problem.not_st: storage unreachable: no chest or barrel at %s
